section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participant demographics for a single study. The sample consisted of 345 participants (191 women and 154 men) from mainland China who were recruited at a university in Hong Kong. Participants ranged in age from 16 to 47 years (M = 22.41, SD = 5.30) with self-reported BMI ranging from 16.02 to 35.69 kg/m² (M = 21.00, SD = 2.93).
